name: Alletorphine
summary: Alletorphine (INN; M-218, R&S-218-M), or N-allylnoretorphine, is an opioid analgesic of the oripavine series which was never marketed.

uses.text: Alletorphine (INN; M-218, R&S-218-M), or N-allylnoretorphine, is an opioid analgesic of the oripavine series which was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids of its family, such as etorphine, are extremely potent, and strong opioids as a class can stop breathing and cause fatal overdose.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同家族的鴉片類如 etorphine 極為強效，而強效鴉片類作為一類可能使呼吸停止並導致致命過量。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同家族的鸦片类如 etorphine 极为强效，而强效鸦片类作为一类可能使呼吸停止并导致致命过量。

fact.en: It belongs to the oripavine family, which includes etorphine, a drug so potent that it is used to tranquillise elephants and rhinos.
fact.zh: 它屬於東罌粟鹼（oripavine）家族，這個家族包括 etorphine，一種強到被用來麻醉大象與犀牛的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它属于东罂粟碱（oripavine）家族，这个家族包括 etorphine，一种强到被用来麻醉大象与犀牛的药物。
